sentences.text: Kuala Lumpur -LRB- -LSB- ˈkwɑːlə ˈlʊmpʊə -RSB- or -LSB- - pər -RSB- -LSB- ˈkwalə ˈlumpʊr -RSB- -RRB- , officially the Federal Territory of Kuala Lumpur , or more commonly KL , is the national capital of Malaysia as well as its largest city .	Federal Territory	Federal Territory (Malaysia)	Malaysia	Malaysia	capital	Capital city
The only alpha world city in Malaysia , it covers an area of 243 km2 and has an estimated population of 1.73 million .	Malaysia	Malaysia	alpha world	Global city

Greater Kuala Lumpur , also known as the Klang Valley , is an urban agglomeration of 7.25 million people .	Greater Kuala Lumpur	Greater Kuala Lumpur	Klang Valley	Klang Valley	urban agglomeration	urban agglomeration
It is among the fastest growing metropolitan regions in South-East Asia , in both population and economic development .

Kuala Lumpur is the cultural , financial and economic centre of Malaysia , home to the Parliament of Malaysia , and the official residence of the Malaysian King , the Istana Negara .	Malaysia	Malaysia	Parliament of Malaysia	Parliament of Malaysia	Malaysian King	Yang di-Pertuan Agong	Istana Negara	Istana Negara, Jalan Duta
The city once held the headquarters of the executive and judicial branches of the federal government as well , but they were moved to Putrajaya in early 1999 .	Putrajaya	Putrajaya
Some sections of the judiciary still remain in Kuala Lumpur .

Kuala Lumpur is one of three Federal Territories of Malaysia , enclaved within the state of Selangor , on the central west coast of Peninsular Malaysia .	Malaysia	Malaysia	Federal Territories of Malaysia	Federal Territory (Malaysia)	enclaved	Enclave and exclave	Selangor	Selangor	Peninsular Malaysia	Peninsular Malaysia

Since the 1990s , the city has played host to many international sporting , political and cultural events including the 1998 Commonwealth Games and the Formula One Grand Prix .	1998 Commonwealth Games	1998 Commonwealth Games	Formula One	Formula One
Kuala Lumpur has undergone rapid development in recent decades .

It is home to the tallest twin buildings in the world , the Petronas Twin Towers , which have become an iconic symbol of Malaysia 's futuristic development .
